Robert Schlegel is a Data Scientist on the OMTAB team at the Laboratoire d'Océanographie de Villefranche, working on the RiOMar and HYPERNETS projects.

## Interests

Marine heatwaves &middot; Climate change &middot; Biodiversity &middot; Machine learning &middot; Data science

## Education

- **PhD in Biodiversity**, University of the Western Cape, 2018
- **MPhil in Marine Science**, University of Cape Town, 2014
- **BA in Animal Behaviour**, University of Washington, 2008
